faqs.a: Yes, as long as the service area is stated honestly. A business covering The Glebe and Barrhaven can describe those areas without implying an office on every street.

faqs.a: A clear description of your case, the areas you cover, how to book a consultation, what it costs, and the proof clients look for before they make contact.

faqs.q: Should I try to target all of Ottawa at once?
faqs.a: Usually not. A profile set to the entire city dilutes relevance. It is more effective to serve your real catchment first, then extend into neighbouring areas with pages of their own.
